versions.content: {DRAFT} Service Name EthTrcv_MacSecAddRxSa (DRAFT) Syntax Std_ReturnType EthTrcv_MacSecAddRxSa ( uint8 TrcvIdx, uint8 An, uint64 LowestPn, uint32 Ssci, const Mka_SakKeyPtrType * KeysPtr, boolean Active ) Service ID [hex] 0x1f Sync/Async Asynchronous Reentrancy Reentrant for different TrcvIdx, Non reentrant for the same TrcvIdx TrcvIdx Index of the Ethernet transceiver within the context of the Ethernet Transceiver Driver An Association Number to use in the MACsec's reception secure association LowestPn Lowest accepted Packet Number in the MACsec's reception secure association Ssci Short Secure Channel Identifiert used in the MACsec's reception secure association KeysPtr Pointer to the SAKs Key (and needed Key information) to use in the MACsec's reception secure association Parameters (in) Active Boolean to enable/disable the MACsec's reception secure association Parameters (inout) None Parameters (out) None Return value Std_ReturnType E_OK: The request has been accepted E_NOT_OK: The request has not been accepted Description Request the Ethernet Transceiver Driver to create a Reception Secure Association in the Transceiver. The Short Secure Channel Identifier is included to support XPN configurations. Tags: atp.Status=DRAFT Available via EthTrcv.h
